title: LPC to/from RC
text: Convert linear prediction coefficients to reflection coefficients or reflection coefficients to linear prediction coefficients, 2 inputs, 4 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {If first input value is not 1} sets Action to take if first input value is not; {Type of conversion}, {Output normalized prediction error power} and {Output LPC filter stability}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of conversion
params.values: Type of conversion RC to LPC (default) | LPC to RC

params.name: Output normalized prediction error power
params.values: Output normalized prediction error power on (default) | off

params.name: Output LPC filter stability
params.values: Output LPC filter stability off (default) | on

params.name: If first input value is not 1
params.values: Action to take if first input value is not 1 Replace it with 1 (default) | Normalize | Normalize and warn | Error
